description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Prosperous Pirates.
When Prosperous Pirates enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Prosperous Pirates trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Prosperous Pirates that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Prosperous Pirates token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
